name: Quick-Witted
text: Your mind moves faster than the conversation. You Upgrade your Focus Die on Tasks to recall information under pressure, notice a lie as it is told, or produce a plan in the space of a breath.

name: Dim-Witted
text: Thoughts arrive late and leave early. You Downgrade your Focus Die on Tasks requiring rapid reasoning or recall under pressure. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Perceptive
text: Little escapes you. You Upgrade your Focus Die on Tasks to spot hidden things, read a room, or catch the detail everyone else walked past.

name: Near-Sighted
text: The world blurs past arm's reach. You Downgrade your Focus Die on sight-based Tasks against anything more than 30ft away. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Agile
text: Your body answers before you finish asking. You Upgrade your Agility Die on Tasks of balance, climbing, tumbling, and squeezing through spaces that should not admit you.

name: Hobble-Footed
text: An old injury, a bad gait, a body that argues. Your Base Speed is 5ft lower and you Downgrade your Agility Die on Tasks of footwork and balance. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Iron-Stomached
text: You have eaten worse and drunk stranger. You Upgrade your Vigor Die on Saves against Poison, disease, and anything a questionable meal could do to a lesser body.

name: Frail Constitution
text: Illness finds you first and leaves you last. You Downgrade your Vigor Die on Saves against Poison and disease. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Steel-Nerved
text: Panic is a thing that happens to other people. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Saves against fear and on Tasks to keep composure under threat, interrogation, or horror.

name: Skittish
text: Your body votes to leave before you are consulted. You Downgrade your Resolve Die on Saves against fear. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Heavy-Handed
text: Doors, crates, and jaws open for you. You Upgrade your Vigor Die on Tasks of raw force — breaking, bending, lifting, holding shut.

name: Lead-Fingered
text: Fine work defeats you. You Downgrade your Agility Die on Tasks of delicate manipulation — locks, knots, stitches, anything smaller than your patience. Taking this Trait grants you one additional Trait choice at creation (tunable).

name: Silver-Tongued
text: Words do what you want them to. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks to persuade, charm, or talk your way past someone whose job is to say no.

name: Commanding Presence
text: Rooms reorganize around you. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks to lead, rally, intimidate, or hold a crowd's attention, and strangers instinctively assume you are in charge.

name: Soothing Manner
text: People calm in your presence. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks to de-escalate, comfort, or coax the frightened, and once per Short Rest an ally who spends the rest in your company may reroll their Vigor Die when recovering Hit Points.

name: Streetwise
text: Every settlement has an underside, and you know its rules. You Upgrade your Focus Die on Tasks to find black markets, read gang signs, spot a tail, or learn who really runs a place.

name: Wilderness-Born
text: The wild raised you. You Upgrade your relevant Attribute Die on Tasks to track, forage, predict weather, and navigate without roads, and you always know which way is north.

name: Scholar's Training
text: You were taught how to learn. You Upgrade your Focus Die on Tasks of research, history, and formal lore, and you read and write every language common to the region unless the GM rules otherwise.

name: Merchant's Eye
text: You know what things are worth and what people will pay. You Upgrade your Focus Die on Tasks to appraise, haggle, or smell a swindle, and you can estimate any mundane item's value on sight.

name: Performer's Charm
text: You know how to hold an audience. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks of performance, storytelling, and first impressions, and a crowd that has seen you perform is one step friendlier to you afterward.

name: Stone-Faced
text: Nothing reaches your face without permission. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks to bluff, withhold, or endure interrogation, and effects that read emotions report only what you choose to show (GM's discretion against magic of Tier 2 or higher).

name: Well-Connected
text: You know someone everywhere. Once per settlement, you may declare a contact — a name, a trade, and how you know them, subject to GM approval — who is disposed to do you one reasonable favor. You Upgrade your Resolve Die on Tasks to work a room for information.
